units.source_text: 在日本学习围棋后返回德国、号称“德国本因坊”的费利克斯·迪瓦尔博士，给名人这场告别赛拍来了贺电。

en.t: Dr. Felix Dival, who had studied Go in Japan before returning to Germany and was known as the German Honinbo, sent a congratulatory telegram for the Master's farewell match.

units.source_text: 晨报刊登了两位棋手阅读博士电报的照片。

en.t: The morning newspaper published a photograph of the two players reading the doctor's telegram.
